summary: Tested new Leave Accrual Audit and Shift Coverage Heatmap report features (backend + frontend). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/reports/leave-accrual-audit (all/single personnel, leave_type filter, missing params 422, personnel not-found 404, 401/403 unauth, no ObjectId) and GET /api/reports/shift-coverage-heatmap (monthly 31-day dates, weekly 7-day dates, grid_data cell schema, station summaries, missing params 422, unauth). Frontend E2E via Playwright: report-type-select dropdown exposes both new options; Leave Accrual Audit shows audit-mode-all / audit-mode-single toggle, audit-leave-type-select with All/Vacation/Sick/Holiday options, single mode reveals audit-personnel-select; report generates and displays audit-person-0 row with Vacation/Sick/Holiday Usage/Accrual/Adjustment sections. Shift Coverage Heatmap toggles monthly/weekly; report renders overall summary cards (Available/Assigned/Declined/Total Hours/Coverage Rate), 8 Station Summary cards with coverage bars, and a 248-cell heatmap grid (8 stations x 31 days) with intensity legend (None/Low/Medium/High/Very High). Hover tooltip is implemented via React state (visible in code, screenshot confirms cell hover ring); no functional issue.
critical_code_review_comments: reports_routes.py leave-accrual-audit: leave_query filters by start_date $gte/$lte only; leave records that begin before start_date but end within the window are excluded. Consider overlap logic ($or on start_date/end_date).
reports_routes.py leave-accrual-audit: hours defaults to 24 in usage aggregation (record.get('hours', 24)); this can mask data-quality issues if a record has a different shift length or 0 hours.
reports_routes.py shift-coverage-heatmap: overtime aggregation uses record.get('hours', 24) with the same silent-default concern as above.

reports_routes.py shift-coverage-heatmap: view_mode param is echoed back but not enforced (client passes date range that already spans monthly or weekly). Consider validating view_mode in ('monthly','weekly') and rejecting others with 422.

reports_routes.py shift-coverage-heatmap: no upper bound on date range - a client requesting a multi-year range would create len(stations)*days cells and could be slow/large. Consider a max span guard (e.g., <= 92 days).
ReportsPage.js is now ~2482 lines - splitting per-report-type sub-components (LeaveAccrualAuditReport, ShiftCoverageHeatmapReport) would improve maintainability and re-render cost.
Landing page video at /api/platform/video/intro_video_a1702399.mp4 returns unsupported streams (FFmpegDemuxer errors in console) - unrelated to this task but visible on load.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seed. No overtime records exist so heatmap shows 0 values (expected per task note); station count = 8 as expected.
